factValues.name: gr:fact-0241a2a105eeb545_fv
factValues.value: Financial Statements for the Year Ended 31 December 2024

factValues.name: gr:fact-a2e52dcd5f131241_fv
factValues.value: The company is entitled to exemption from audit under Section 477 of the Companies Act 2006 for the year ended 31 December 2024.

factValues.name: gr:fact-5216a11ae949794e_fv
factValues.value: The members have not required the company to obtain an audit of its financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2024 in accordance with Section 476 of the Companies Act 2006.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9b2b86ac33c709d8_fv
factValues.value: The directors acknowledge their responsibilities for:(a)ensuring that the company keeps accounting records which comply with Sections 386 and 387 of the Companies Act 2006 and (b)preparing financial statements which give a true and fair view of the state of affairs of the company as at the end of each financial year and of its profit or loss for each financial year in accordance with the requirements of Sections 394 and 395 and which otherwise comply with the requirements of the Companies Act 2006 relating to financial statements, so far as applicable to the company.

factValues.name: gr:fact-1b14c3767ae61f3a_fv
factValues.value: The financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-44f4c12d235a41a1_fv
factValues.value: In accordance with Section 444 of the Companies Act 2006, the Income Statement has not been delivered.

factValues.name: gr:fact-1853feaac41fd34e_fv
factValues.value: The presentation currency of the financial statements is the Pound Sterling (£).

factValues.name: gr:fact-810483abd419e597_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with Financial Reporting Standard 102 "The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the UK and Republic of Ireland" including the provisions of Section 1A "Small Entities" and the Companies Act 2006. The financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention.

factValues.name: gr:fact-2b150d2229ff084e_fv
factValues.value: The company operates a defined contribution pension scheme.  Contributions payable to the company's pension scheme are charged to profit or loss in the period to which they relate.
